## What's new in 1.1.1

**Case Amplify carousels**
- No point numbers (01, 02) on panels, along with no page counter and no wave line.
- Stat figures stay at 3 characters or fewer (41%, 88%) so the big type never oversets; the build reports longer ones.
- Charts work on any panel: larger text for phones, and on-dark colors with solid bars on dark and purple panels.
- Stat labels on dark panels are now readable.
